paper.title_en: Algebraic structure in holographic tensor networks
paper.abstract_en: In a previous work 2511.21852, we explored the hypothesis that in general theories of quantum gravity, spacetime regions known as generalized entanglement wedges (introduced by Bousso and Penington) have an associated subalgebra of observables in a semiclassical limit. We defined an entropy associated with these subalgebras that obeys the same monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties as the generalized gravitational entropy of generalized entanglement wedges. Here, we test aspects of these ideas making use of tensor network toy models for holography. In this context, the analog of a generalized entanglement wedge is a region for which no region containing it has a smaller number of boundary legs. In the limit of large bond dimension (analogous to the semiclassical limit), we argue that each such region has a canonically associated subalgebra of the full algebra of observables on the boundary Hilbert space, as well as a family of unitarily related von Neumann factor subalgebras. We investigate in detail how various algebraic operations on these subalgebras (e.g. their intersections, joins, and commutants) are related to corresponding geometrical operations on the tensor network regions. We study to what extent the monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties of generalized entropy for generalized entanglement wedges follow from properties of our algebraic entropy. We also introduce an alternative entropic quantity $S(ω|| ω\circ E_{\mathcal{A}'})$ associated with a subalgebra $\mathcal{A}$ that also obeys monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties with suitable conditions. Finally, we explain how to define a type $II_1$ von Neumann algebra based on an infinite family of random tensor networks with increasing bond dimension such that the regions corresponding to generalized entanglement wedges can be associated with exact subalgebras of this full algebra.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在张量网络玩具模型中系统研究广义纠缠楔的代数结构与子代数性质，涉及 von Neumann 代数、广义熵以及与几何操作的对应关系，理论深度高，方法具体且创新性明显，值得全息与量子引力方向的读者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 全息张量网络中的代数结构
decision.abstract_zh: 在先前的工作 2511.21852 中，我们探索了这样一个假设：在一般的量子引力理论中，被称为广义纠缠楔（由 Bousso 和 Penington 引入）的时空区域在半经典极限下具有一个相关联的可观测量子子代数。我们定义了与这些子代数相关的熵，它满足与广义纠缠楔的广义引力熵相同的单调性和强次可加性性质。在这里，我们利用全息的张量网络玩具模型来检验这些思想的若干方面。在此语境下，广义纠缠楔的类似物是一个区域，其任何包含该区域的区域都不具有更少的边界腿数。在大键维度极限（类似于半经典极限）下，我们论证每个这样的区域都典范地关联着边界希尔伯特空间上完整可观测代数的一个子代数，以及一族通过酉变换相关的 von Neumann 因子子代数。我们详细研究了这些子代数上的各种代数运算（例如它们的交、并与交换子）如何与张量网络区域上的相应几何运算相关联。我们研究了广义纠缠楔的广义熵的单调性和强次可加性在多大程度上可由我们代数熵的性质推出。我们还引入了一个与子代数 $\mathcal{A}$ 相关的替代熵量 $S(\omega|| \omega\circ E_{\mathcal{A}'})$，它在适当条件下也满足单调性和强次可加性。最后，我们解释了如何基于键维度递增的无限族随机张量网络定义一个 type $II_1$ von Neumann 代数，使得与广义纠缠楔对应的区域能够与这个完整代数的精确子代数相关联。
